verses.1: “For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”
verses.2: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, + 4:2 Or the Sun of Righteousness will rise with healing in His wings and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
verses.3: Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,” says the LORD of Hosts.
verses.4: “Remember the law of My servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb. + 4:4 That is, Mount Sinai, or possibly a mountain in the range containing Mount Sinai
verses.5: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome + 4:5 Or dreadful ; LXX glorious Day of the LORD.
verses.6: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers. + 4:6 Cited in Luke 1:17|LUK 1:17 Otherwise, I will come and strike the land with a curse.”

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
